name: decisions
description: Decisions Claude leaves for you are asked one by one with AskUserQuestion, or listed and answered item by item in a form; Claude then carries on with your answers.

mode.title: How decisions reach you
mode.description: ask: Claude asks each decision with the question dialog and carries on in the same turn. form: Claude lists them under a Decisions heading and you answer each in a form (/decisions). Takes effect in new sessions.
